name: How much does an ADU kitchen cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of an ADU kitchen build in Los Angeles, and what drives the price?
mainEntity.text: What is the typical cost of an ADU kitchen build in Los Angeles, and what drives the price?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an ADU kitchen in Los Angeles depends on how much of the work is new construction versus conversion, and on the finish level selected. A basic compact kitchen with stock cabinets and standard appliances will cost far less than a custom luxury kitchen with stone counters, built-in appliances, and upgraded lighting. The biggest price drivers are often not the visible finishes, but the hidden infrastructure: plumbing lines, electrical upgrades, venting, drywall, tile work, and any structural framing changes needed to fit the kitchen layout. In many ADU projects, the kitchen cost also rises when homeowners add dishwashers, full-size ranges, extra storage, or premium fixtures. A useful way to compare bids is to separate the kitchen into buckets: cabinetry, countertops, plumbing, electrical, appliances, finishes, and labor. That makes it easier to spot whether one bid is missing a major item. For homeowners in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, and surrounding areas, the best value usually comes from a design that looks custom without overcomplicating the build.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU kitchen cost in Los Angeles varies widely based on size, cabinet quality, appliance package, plumbing, electrical upgrades, and whether the space is a new build or conversion. Compact kitchens cost less than custom luxury layouts, but utility upgrades and custom finishes can raise the total quickly.
